sentence: Middle son of three brothers (the other two are healthy).
He is married and has no children.
Not a drinker, nor a smoker.
Recurrent tonsillitis in childhood, undergoing surgery at age 6.
Normal analysis with slight persistent elevation of transaminases.
The duodenal biopsy showed moderate atrophy of the intestinal villi, accompanied by significant inflammatory infiltrate, at the level of the lamina propria (Marsh stage 3b).
He has been on GSD for 2 years, with good clinical and analytical response.
